evals.name: board-memo-from-source
evals.prompt: Use $document to turn evals/artifact-skills/document/source/board_notes.md into a concise board memo with a clear recommendation, source map, and predicted reader questions. Keep the source as Markdown and describe the DOCX export route.
assertions: Creates a structured written memo, not slides
Keeps Markdown or structured source as source of truth
Includes recommendation, source fidelity, and reader-question check
Does not invent facts beyond the supplied source
Mentions DOCX export as a route rather than silently downgrading

evals.name: review-comments-redline-route
evals.prompt: Use $document to review evals/artifact-skills/document/source/policy_draft.md as if it will become a DOCX with comments. Produce actionable comments, identify unclear claims, and state how tracked changes would be handled if a native DOCX were supplied.
assertions: Takes a review/comment stance rather than rewriting everything blindly
Identifies unclear claims and reader risks
Explains native DOCX comments/tracked changes route only if DOCX is available
Runs or references Markdown/document structural checks

evals.name: should-not-handle-workbook-model
evals.prompt: Build an Excel model from evals/artifact-skills/document/source/pricing_inputs.csv with assumptions, formulas, named input cells, and a validation sheet. The workbook should recalculate when assumptions change.
assertions: Does not use document as the primary skill
Identifies formulas and recalculation as spreadsheet responsibilities
Avoids presenting a Markdown table as the final artifact
